beliefs.belief: Did what was asked at Farpoint: the docking, the away teams. Whether he will tell me what I don't want to hear is still open.
Brought me the one item that could not wait and held the rest. Called it a suspicion, not a finding. Good.
Prepares for my decision without presuming it. And wants to be in the council chamber; he must remember he is a guest there.
He sees the ship's mood before it reaches me. Useful. The families are precisely what I'd rather not manage.

recent: Number One asked for twenty minutes at 1400, two items
received Starfleet Medical's relay; diverted to Hesker IV at warp 8; called senior staff for 1300
Number One brought the latch-four restriction to him at once and held the rest; made it a standing order
1300 briefing: Crusher's summary of the Hesker IV reports
ruled: no habitat destroyed on a hypothesis
ruled no patients aboard until Crusher has the virus under a microscope; briefing still open; Number One's two items still to hear
Number One stayed after the briefing; took Yar's correction with good grace
Number One's two items: latch four (drydock after Hesker, or clear space), Yar's intruder protocol (to read before signing); internal sensors never logged Q
Number One vouched for La Forge: saw Q through the VISOR, noticed something wrong, cleared by MacDougal
La Forge's VISOR account of Q, via Number One; ordered it into Data's file in La Forge's own words
Data's Q file arrived, with La Forge's account
signed Number One's request to Starfleet Medical
Number One proposes a ship-wide note on Hesker IV before rumour; told him to draft it, Troi to see it first, then him
